aboutSection.title: Who We Are
aboutSection.description: Aqua Pro International Swimming Academy is Skopje's premier swim training center, offering world-class instruction in a safe, structured, and motivating environment. With internationally certified coaches and personalized programs, we help swimmers of all ages unlock their full potential – whether it’s their first splash or the road to competition.

about.title: Recognisable for elite organisation, professional work by the coaches, healthy swimmers, and happy parents
about.visionText: Swimming club AQUA PRO – ACADEMY, through a professional coaching program, to enable every swimmer to gradually and in a healthy way develop their swimming skills to the limit of their capabilities. To be a club from which top and quality swimmers will emerge, representatives who will represent the country in major European and world competitions. Let's advocate for the introduction of swimming in primary schools as a compulsory sport, and the promotion of lifelong swimming as an integral part of modern and cultural living.
about.missionText: Our mission is for every child to develop swimming skills from a young age, to raise the quality of sports swimming to the highest level, to increase the mass of swimming in Skopje and beyond, and to run the club in a modern and high-quality way. Our club should be recognised for top organisation, professional work of trainers, healthy swimmers and satisfied parents.

coaches.title: MEET THE COACHES
coaches.intro: Our coaching staff consists of professionals with many years of experience both in and out of the swimming pool. Professors of physical education, Masters of sports management, physiotherapists, former and current national champions and record holders — they are all helping your children learn the sport we all love in the best way possible.

data.name: Martin Stefanovski
data.about: Martin Stefanovski Master's Degree in Sports Management. Professional swimmer, multinational record holder, participant and medallist in numerous major international competitions of European and world character. In 2007, he became a member of the national swimming team, participating in the Balkan Games in Athens. Through his international experience as a swimmer, he took part in the World University Games in Shenzhen - China (2011), Gwangju - Korea (2015), and Taipei - Taiwan (2017) as a coach of the national team.

data.name: Sotir Trajkovski- Coci
data.about: Graduated Economist. National representative and record holder, participant and medalist in international competitions, youngest swimmer to complete the Ohrid Marathon. Has 10 years of experience as a coach, with many successful students and international competitors.

data.name: Jovan Vaklinski
data.about: Graduated physiotherapist. Has extensive coaching experience and a background in aquatics. Former player for Macedonia's National Waterpolo Team. Participated in therapeutic swimming and hydro kinesiotherapy projects.

data.name: Stefan Stefanovski
data.about: Graduated physiotherapist. Many years of swimming experience, multiple-time national champion and former record holder, with outstanding results in both national and international competitions.

data.name: Vesna Trajkovska Sterjov
data.about: Graduated professor of physical culture. Member of the national team of Macedonia with appearances in numerous competitions including Balkan Games, European and World Youth Championships. Current National Record Holder. Competed at the Ohrid Marathon 4 times. 15 years of experience as a swimming coach.

data.name: Level 1
data.description: This beginner level builds a foundation to help children feel comfortable with basic swimming skills.
data.goals: Overcome fear, proper breath control, comfort with submersion, independence floating on front and back, wall push-offs, back float safety position, and basic backstroke.

data.name: Level 2
data.description: This advanced beginner level helps swimmers control their breathing while swimming.
data.goals: Proper movement in water using basic freestyle and backstroke techniques and breath control.

data.name: Level 3
data.description: Teaches swimmers breath control and efficient swimming to gain independence in water.
data.goals: Mastering freestyle and backstroke technique, side breathing, and intro to breaststroke.

data.name: Level 4
data.description: Helps swimmers develop effective coordination of arms, legs, breathing, and body position.
data.goals: Rhythmic freestyle, improved backstroke, breaststroke timing, and water feel drills.

data.name: Level 5
data.description: Helps students refine underwater skills in freestyle, backstroke, sidestroke, and butterfly.
data.goals: Demonstrate freestyle with rhythmic breathing, backstroke, breaststroke, treading water, sidestroke, and butterfly basics.

data.name: Level 6
data.description: Advanced group focuses on strengthening strokes and building endurance.
data.goals: Swim longer distances in all strokes with ease and learn flip turns.

competitionSquad.title: COMPETITION SQUAD
competitionSquad.leadCoachExperience: Has 10 years of experience as a coach, with lots of successful young swimmers and competitors on an international stage.
competitionSquad.leadCoachAchievements: National representative and record holder, participant and medalist in international competitions, youngest swimmer to complete the Ohrid Marathon.
competitionSquad.pathwayParagraph1: Since its foundation, the goal of the Aqua Pro Swimming Academy has been to support the development of each swimmer to reach their true swimming potential. Over time, Aqua Pro's reputation has steadily increased. The level of our swimmers has increased not only locally, but also worldwide, now the most successful swimmers in Macedonia and the region are training in Aqua Pro.
competitionSquad.pathwayParagraph2: Our team structure is designed to be progressive, for swimmers to develop through levels in accordance with a long-term athlete development plan. We have four competitor levels (10-12, 13-15, 16+, Elite) which allow each swimmer to develop and train according to their correct age, ability, commitment, goals and potential. This structure allows swimmers of all abilities and dedication to enjoy the sport equally.
competitionSquad.pathwayParagraph3: The Competition Pathway has evolved to support swimmers who aim to train and compete. Training is carried out with an individual program, but most importantly according to the correct age and ability - this allows swimmers to choose their commitment to be in line with their goals.

hero.title: Skiing, Swimming and Winter Adventure in Borovets
hero.p1: Take advantage of the opportunity for an unforgettable winter sports camp! Aqua Pro Winter Camp 2026 is intended for children who love sports, fun, new friendships and spending their winter holidays actively.
hero.p2: The camp offers a unique combination of skiing, swimming and educational training sessions, under 24-hour supervision by professional coaches.

why.title: Why Aqua Pro Winter Camp?
why.item1: 5 days of skiing at the most famous winter resort in Bulgaria
why.item2: Swimming and training program in a covered 25m pool
why.item5: Perfect conditions for children 7+ years old
why.p1: The camp is ideal for children who want to improve their sports skills, build self-confidence and enjoy nature and sports activities.

included.title: What is included in the price?
included.item1: Accommodation at Hotel Arena* – 6 nights, full board (buffet style)
included.item4: Educational workshops about healthy nutrition and sport
included.notIncluded: Not included: travel insurance, ski equipment rental, ski pass and ski instructor.

location.title: Location: Borovets
location.p1: Borovets is one of the best winter resorts in the Balkans, with modern ski lifts, slopes for beginners and advanced skiers, numerous snow sports and activities, as well as excellent hotel and entertainment facilities.
location.p2: This location is chosen for its safety, modern conditions and great opportunities for sports training.
